title: REST auth service calls non-existent static/async storage APIs
description: BagistoApiService uses SharedPreferenceHelper.getCustomerToken()/getRefreshToken() as static async methods, but SharedPreferenceHelper provides instance synchronous methods via GetStorage and has no refresh token methods.
reproduction_steps: Static analysis: open bagisto_api_service.dart and shared_preference_helper.dart; the referenced static methods do not exist.
suggested_fix: Add refresh token keys and instance methods in SharedPreferenceHelper; update BagistoApiService to use appStoragePref instance (sync) methods.
tests_to_add: Unit test to verify tokens are loaded on initialize() and cleared on logout().
impact_if_unfixed: Build/runtime errors and broken auth flows, high repair cost.

title: Two parallel networking stacks with no boundary (GraphQL + REST)
description: The codebase maintains a GraphQL client (ApiClient/MutationsData) and a REST client (BagistoApiService) without any shared interface, leading to duplicated behavior and divergence.
reproduction_steps: Static: inspect services/ folder; both stacks implement similar cart/orders/auth flows.
suggested_fix: Introduce an abstract repository interface (e.g., AuthRepository, ProductRepository, CartRepository) and provide GraphQL and REST implementations. Wire via DI and gradually migrate.
tests_to_add: Contract tests for the repositories to ensure GraphQL and REST implementations behave consistently.
impact_if_unfixed: Feature drift, duplicated fixes, bugs reintroduced across stacks.

title: Monolithic mutation_query.dart with string-built queries
description: This file centralizes most API queries/mutations as large string templates, mixing concerns and increasing edit risk.
reproduction_steps: Static: open mutation_query.dart; note volume, inline string assembly, and TODOs.
suggested_fix: Split by feature (auth_mutations.dart, cart_mutations.dart, etc.), use GraphQL variables consistently, consider graphql-codegen for typed models.
tests_to_add: Snapshot tests for query strings per feature; integration tests asserting server compatibility.
impact_if_unfixed: Difficult to understand/modify; high chance of subtle breaking edits.

title: Duplicate configuration sources and magic constants
description: Two separate configuration systems define similar values (baseDomain/apiUrl/locale/currency), with hardcoded placeholders and keys.
reproduction_steps: Static: inspect both files; note duplication and conflicting defaults (REST vs GraphQL endpoints).
suggested_fix: Consolidate config into a single source with flavor/environment support, eliminate hardcoded keys, document overrides.
tests_to_add: Config resolution unit tests for dev/staging/prod flavors.
impact_if_unfixed: Inconsistent behavior per module, hard-to-track environment issues.

title: Global HTTP override disabling certificate validation
description: MyHttpOverrides permanently disables TLS verification. This should be gated for local dev only; otherwise it invites accidental insecure builds and confusion.
suggested_fix: Enable HttpOverrides only in debug profile; avoid blanket overrides in production.
tests_to_add: Build-time assert test that release builds do not set HttpOverrides.
impact_if_unfixed: Risk of insecure builds; developers get used to bypasses and miss proper cert issues.

title: Minimal lint rules; prints and undocumented APIs slip through
description: Only default flutter_lints are enabled; frequent print(), no documentation linting, and no type/async best-practice enforcement.
suggested_fix: Adopt a stricter lint set (very_good_analysis or curated set) and CI gate on lint failures.
impact_if_unfixed: Inconsistent code quality, new contributors struggle to follow conventions.

title: Dependency constraints are missing for some packages
description: permission_handler and device_info_plus have no versions, inviting unpredictable resolution changes.
reproduction_steps: Static: open pubspec.yaml; note unspecified versions.
suggested_fix: Pin versions and add a quarterly dependency review process.
impact_if_unfixed: Random build failures and time lost diagnosing transitive updates.

title: ApiClient.addToCart mixes concerns and flows
description: Function handles multipart branching, input shaping, and response parsing in one place, making it harder to test and extend.
reproduction_steps: Static: inspect addToCart method; see multipart path vs standard mutation path and response handling.
suggested_fix: Extract upload builder and response parsing to dedicated helpers; reduce function surface.
tests_to_add: Unit tests per branch (multipart vs non-multipart), validating request maps and parsing.
impact_if_unfixed: New options break existing flows; changes are difficult to safely introduce.

title: Console print logging in networking code
description: print() calls scatter logs; no centralized logger/levels/formatting.
reproduction_steps: Static: open bagisto_api_service.dart; see print in interceptors.
suggested_fix: Use a logging facade (e.g., logger) and route logs based on environment; add tags.
impact_if_unfixed: Noisy logs and manual cleanup for production builds.

title: Test gap across critical flows
description: Only the default widget_test.dart exists; no unit tests for auth, cart, or parsing. Refactors are risky.
suggested_fix: Add unit tests for token handling, auth calls, cart mutations; add mocks to isolate network.
tests_to_add: Add concrete tests for token lifecycle in BagistoApiService and for parsing of product list/cart responses.
impact_if_unfixed: Refactors and bugfixes can regress silently.
